te: A supernova, called SN 1054, is seen by Chinese Song dynasty, Arab, and possibly indigenous American observers near the…
dz: 一颗被称作SN 1054的超新星被中国宋朝,阿拉伯人所见,可能还有星泽塔陶里附近的土着美国观察家所见. 几个月来,它仍然非常明亮,可以在白天看到。 其残留形成蟹状星云.
de: A supernova, called SN 1054, is seen by Chinese Song dynasty, Arab, and possibly indigenous American observers near the star Zeta Tauri. For several months it remains bright enough to be seen during the day. Its remnants form the Crab Nebula.

t: 三位罗马议员在星期六下午的神灵仪式上,在Hagia Sophia的祭坛上,将一头反对君士坦丁堡…
te: Three Roman legates place - acting illegally on their own authority - a bull of excommunication against Michael I Cerul…
dz: 三位罗马议员在星期六下午的神灵仪式上,在Hagia Sophia的祭坛上,将一头反对君士坦丁堡宗主迈克尔一世·塞鲁莱乌斯的公牛非法置于自己的权力之下。 历史学家经常将事件描述为"东西施教"的正式起步.
de: Three Roman legates place - acting illegally on their own authority - a bull of excommunication against Michael I Cerularius, the patriarch of Constantinople, and his followers on the altar of Hagia Sophia during Saturday afternoon divine liturgy. Historians frequently describe the event as the formal start of the East–West Schism.

t: 西沃德,诺森布里亚的厄尔(英语:Earl of Northumbria)入侵苏格兰并击败了苏格…
te: Siward, Earl of Northumbria, invades Scotland and defeats Macbeth, King of Scotland, somewhere north of the Firth of Fo…
dz: 西沃德,诺森布里亚的厄尔(英语:Earl of Northumbria)入侵苏格兰并击败了苏格兰国王麦克白(英语:Macbeth (firth of Forth)). 这被称为"邓西南之战".
de: Siward, Earl of Northumbria, invades Scotland and defeats Macbeth, King of Scotland, somewhere north of the Firth of Forth. This is known as the Battle of Dunsinane.
